'''Jorland''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of [[Storm Squad]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He, along with the rest of Storm Squad, fell in battle while [[Attack on the Dorin's Sky|unsuccessfully defending]] the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'' from Imperial boarders.
